title: When Edge Independence Fails: Joint Graph Diffusion with Latent Sociability Priors
abstract: arXiv:2610.13765v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models corrupt graph structure through independent edge updates with a Markovian noise model. Combined with the exchangeability requirement on the output distribution, the terminal prior is necessarily an Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi (E-R) random graph. This has a fundamental consequence for unconditional graph generation without node features: in the large graph limit, any GNN denoiser applied to an E-R graph approximately outputs an E-R graph, making effective denoising difficult. In practice, generated graphs fail to recover meaningful node heterogeneity and higher-order structure. Previous models introduced specialized node features to compensate, framing this as an expressivity problem, while the role of the prior remained unexamined. We instead address the root cause by introducing the Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) and a join} diffusion process that co-evolves latent node sociability variables and graph structure,

translated_title: 当边独立性失效时：基于潜在社交性先验的联合图扩散
translated_abstract: 离散图扩散模型通过具有马尔可夫噪声模型的独立边更新来破坏图结构。结合对输出分布的交换性要求，终端先验必然是Erdős–Rényi（E-R）随机图。这对无节点特征的无条件图生成具有根本性的影响：在大图极限下，任何应用于E-R图的GNN去噪器都近似输出E-R图，使得有效去噪变得困难。在实践中，生成的图无法恢复有意义的节点异质性和高阶结构。以往的模型引入专门的节点特征来弥补这一问题，将其归结为表达能力问题，而先验的作用则未被审视。我们转而从根本原因入手，引入潜在社交性先验（LSP）和一种联合扩散过程，使潜在节点社交性变量与图结构共同演化。
tldr: 本文指出离散图扩散模型的E-R随机图先验是GNN去噪器失效的根本原因，并提出潜在社交性先验（LSP）与联合扩散过程，使节点社交性变量与图结构共同演化，从而恢复生成图中的节点异质性和高阶结构。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the Erdős–Rényi prior as the root cause of GNN denoiser failure in discrete graph diffusion models and proposes a Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) with a joint diffusion process that co-evolves latent node sociability variables and graph structure to recover node heterogeneity and higher-order structure.
